formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj], (∃ c : Fin n → Bool, ∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → c u ≠ c v) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → 2 ≤ G.edgeFinset.card → ∃ z : Fin n, 0 < G.degree z ∧ ∀ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n D = (fun y : Fin n → Bool => @decide (∃ a b : Fin n, (G.deleteEdges (G.incidenceSet z)).Adj a b ∧ y a = true ∧ y b = true) (Classical.propDecidable _)) ∧ D.size + G.degree z ≤ C.size ∧ ((∃ S : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover (G.deleteEdges (G.incidenceSet z)) S ∧ ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover G T → S.card < T.card) → D.size + G.degree z + 1 ≤ C.size)
plain_statement: H is a bipartite graph on n vertices with no 4-cycle and at least two edges; f_H is true when both ends of some edge are true. A circuit here has AND and OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires, every gate counted. Then H has a vertex z on at least one edge such that every such circuit for f_H with s gates gives one for f of H minus the edges at z with at most s - deg(z) gates, and with at most s - deg(z) - 1 gates when H minus those edges has a smaller least vertex cover than H.
title: 4-cycle-free bipartite edge function: some vertex z whose cut saves at least deg(z) AND/OR fan-in-two gates, plus 1 if the cover number drops
